item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 22/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. Showers will be heavy at times. An area of low pressure may also form over the trough of low pressure over the waters of eastern Guangdong today and tomorrow. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China this morning. The weather will be windy and slightly cooler over the region early this week. With the broad trough of low pressure weakening, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. Besides, the area of low pressure over the East China Sea will bring unsettled weather to the region today and tomorrow.
